title: Permissive-First Parameter Adaptor and Remediation Hints for Function Calls
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Implement a permissive-first parameter adaptor that accepts common deviations from the declared JSON parameter schema and returns actionable remediation hints rather than hard errors. Purpose: reduce visible failures when models produce slightly malformed function-call payloads, capture telemetry for common failure modes, and provide a clear, internationalizable error/repair catalog that client SDKs can surface to developers and end-users.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime accepts and adapts at least 5 common schema deviations (missing optional props, stringified numbers, extra keys, flattened nested objects, and enum-casing mismatches) without failing the entire request.
When adapt succeeds, a validation patch is included in telemetry and response metadata (validation_level=permissive, patches=[...]).
When adapt fails to fix payload, runtime returns a structured error code with remediation_hint and an i18n key. No raw stack traces are exposed to the client.
Client SDKs (JS & Python) map remediation_hint -> suggested fix UI with links to docs; mapping documented in runtime-2.4 release notes.
All validation failure types emit telemetry events described in this ticket and are instrumented in Datadog dashboards (errors per 1000 calls, top failure types).
Migration toggle: feature behind config flag call_schema_permissive=true that can be enabled per-tenant.
E2E tests covering adaptation and non-adaptive failure modes included in CI; test coverage > 90% for new validation module.
Security review completed for potential injection risks introduced by permissive coercions.
notes: We prioritize permissive adaptors for user-facing SDKs to improve developer UX and reduce noisy errors in production flows.
Trade-offs: permissive behavior can mask model hallucinations; mitigation is telemetry + conservative default (off for enterprise tenants until explicitly enabled).
We must avoid arbitrary type coercions that could lead to security issues; all coercions will be whitelist-based with unit tests.
Will reuse existing schema registry and augment with a "coercion_profile" attribute per function manifest.
Plan to add an allowlist for fields that can be coerced; by default only primitives and small structural adjustments are allowed.
implementation_plan: 1. Design adaptor interface and patch/diagnostic payload shape (2 days).
2. Implement core coercion engine (string->number, number->string, enum case-insensitive match, auto-unwrap single-item arrays, flatten simple nested wrappers) (6 days).
3. Add validation metadata: validation_level, patches[], validation_error_code when fatal (4 days).
4. Instrument telemetry events and create Datadog dashboard (2 days).
5. Add per-tenant feature flag and rollout controls in control plane (3 days).
6. Implement SDK mapping for remediation hints (JS + Python) and doc pages (2 days).
7. Security review and fuzz testing (3 days).
8. Integration tests, canary rollout, monitor SLOs, iterate (ongoing).

sample_error_catalog: VAL_001_MISSING_REQUIRED: Fatal - required parameter missing. remediation_hint=add_missing_field. i18n_key=validation.missing_required
VAL_002_TYPE_MISMATCH: Non-fatal - value coerced (e.g., '123' -> 123). remediation_hint=check_types. i18n_key=validation.type_mismatch
VAL_003_ENUM_NO_MATCH: Non-fatal - case-insensitive enum match applied ("Small" -> "SMALL"). remediation_hint=use_canonical_enum. i18n_key=validation.enum_mismatch
VAL_004_EXTRA_FIELDS: Non-fatal - extra unknown fields removed. remediation_hint=prune_extra_fields. i18n_key=validation.extra_fields
VAL_005_FLATTENED_OBJECT: Non-fatal - auto-unwrapped single-key wrapper fixed. remediation_hint=flatten_nesting. i18n_key=validation.flattened_object
VAL_900_COERCION_REJECTED: Fatal - coercion not permitted. remediation_hint=provide_expected_schema. i18n_key=validation.coercion_rejected
telemetry_events: call.validation.permissive.patch_applied - tags: function, tenant, patch_types, latency_ms
call.validation.failure.fatal - tags: function, tenant, error_code, sample_payload_hash
call.validation.stats - daily aggregates emitted for total calls, patches_applied, failures
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Internal alpha - enable flag for internal tenants only and collect telemetry (2 weeks).
Phase 2: Beta - invite 5 customers with opt-in toggle, validate metrics and false-positive rate (3 weeks).
Phase 3: Gradual enable - per-region rollout with automatic rollback if fatal failure rate > 0.5% above baseline (4 weeks).
